stubs.name: BMOV
stubs.note: Mitsubishi block move: copies n words starting at s to d (EN, s, n, d). A block copy of n words cannot be written with scalar parameters, so the body is left empty.

stubs.name: BON
stubs.note: Bit ON check: d is TRUE when bit n of s is ON. The result goes to the 4th argument, not the return value.

stubs.name: c_AM_ALARMS_NUM
stubs.note: Upper bound of AM_ALARMS. The application chooses the value; I used the documented maximum, 127.

stubs.name: c_AM_EVENTS_NUM
stubs.note: Upper bound of AM_EVENTS. The application chooses the value; I used the documented maximum, 127.

stubs.name: D0Z4
stubs.note: Index-register device D0 offset by Z4, modelled as an INT (it is passed to F_SCALE as an INT argument).

stubs.name: D0Z5
stubs.note: Index-register device D0 offset by Z5. It is read and written as an INT (a WORD value is also assigned to it).

stubs.name: D0Z6
stubs.note: Index-register device D0 offset by Z6, passed to F_SCALE as an INT.

stubs.name: D0Z7
stubs.note: Index-register device D0 offset by Z7, passed to F_SCALE as an INT.

stubs.name: D600
stubs.note: Data register D600 (holds packed alarm words), read as an INT.

stubs.name: D610
stubs.note: Data register D610 (holds packed event words), read as an INT.

stubs.name: D8010
stubs.note: Special register holding the current scan time in 0.1 ms units.

stubs.name: D8020Z3
stubs.note: Input-filter-time special register offset by Z3. MOV writes an INT to it.

stubs.name: D8030Z3
stubs.note: Analog-input special register offset by Z3, read as an INT.

stubs.name: DBON
stubs.note: 32-bit version of BON: d is TRUE when bit n of the DWORD s is ON.

stubs.name: DDIV
stubs.note: 32-bit signed division: d[0] is the quotient and d[1] the remainder. The call sites pass ARRAY [0..1] OF DWORD for d.

stubs.name: DINC
stubs.note: 32-bit increment of d when EN is TRUE. The call sites pass the DWORD tickers TCO_DINT_10 and TCO_DINT_50.

stubs.name: DINT_TO_TIME
stubs.declaration:
FUNCTION DINT_TO_TIME : TIME
VAR_INPUT
    IN : DINT;
END_VAR
END_FUNCTION
stubs.note: Standard conversion from DINT milliseconds to TIME. The body is empty because RuSTy stores TIME in nanoseconds, so a direct assignment would give the wrong units.

stubs.name: DMOV
stubs.note: 32-bit move: copies s to d when EN is TRUE.

stubs.name: DMUL
stubs.note: 32-bit multiply instruction (TimeControl docs). The 64-bit product goes into d[0] (low word) and d[1] (high word). The body is left empty because the signed 64-bit split is not modelled; d keeps its value.

stubs.name: DROL
stubs.note: Mitsubishi 32-bit rotate-left instruction. The argument order (EN, n, d) is taken from the call sites; d is rotated in place.

stubs.name: DSUB
stubs.note: 32-bit subtract instruction: d := s1 - s2 using raw 32-bit subtraction that wraps around safely, as the TimeControl docs describe.

stubs.name: DWORD_TO_TIME
stubs.declaration:
FUNCTION DWORD_TO_TIME : TIME
VAR_INPUT
    IN : DWORD;
END_VAR
END_FUNCTION
stubs.note: Standard type conversion. In GX Works, TIME is in ms; in RuSTy it is in ns. Because the units differ, the body is left empty.

stubs.name: EI
stubs.declaration:
FUNCTION EI : BOOL
VAR_INPUT
    EN : BOOL;
END_VAR
END_FUNCTION
stubs.note: Enable-interrupts instruction. It changes CPU interrupt state, so the body is empty.

stubs.name: F_SEC_TO_TCO_50
stubs.note: Converts seconds to a 50 ms tick count (DWORD): seconds * 20.

stubs.name: F_SRB
stubs.note: Utils helper: sets or resets bit iBN (0-based) of a WORD according to xValue and returns the modified WORD. The parameter names are assumed.

stubs.name: F_TCO_50_DIFF
stubs.note: Number of ticks elapsed between a saved ticker value and the current one, using DWORD subtraction that wraps around safely.

stubs.name: INC
stubs.note: 16-bit increment instruction: adds 1 to d when EN is TRUE.

stubs.name: K0
stubs.note: Mitsubishi decimal constant K0.

stubs.name: K15
stubs.note: Mitsubishi decimal constant K15.

stubs.name: K31
stubs.note: Mitsubishi decimal constant K31.

stubs.name: K4M600
stubs.note: Digit-specified device covering M600..M615, modelled as a WORD.

stubs.name: LIMITATION
stubs.note: GX Works standard limiter with argument order LIMITATION(MN, IN, MX). The inputs are widened to DINT so both INT and DINT arguments are accepted.

stubs.name: M0Z3
stubs.note: Index-register-modified bit device M0Z3, modelled as a plain BOOL.

stubs.name: MEF
stubs.declaration:
FUNCTION MEF : BOOL
VAR_INPUT
    IN : BOOL;
END_VAR
END_FUNCTION
stubs.note: Falling-edge detector (TRUE for one scan when IN goes TRUE->FALSE). Needs previous-scan state, which a stub function cannot hold, so it always returns FALSE.

stubs.name: MEP
stubs.declaration:
FUNCTION MEP : BOOL
VAR_INPUT
    IN : BOOL;
END_VAR
END_FUNCTION
stubs.note: Rising-edge detector (TRUE for one scan when IN goes FALSE->TRUE). Needs previous-scan state, which a stub function cannot hold, so it always returns FALSE.

stubs.name: MOV
stubs.note: GX Works MOV(EN, s, d): copies s to d when EN is TRUE, otherwise d is left unchanged. A function output cannot leave d unchanged, so the body is empty. Destinations are INT/WORD devices and labels.

stubs.name: R0Z5
stubs.note: File register R0 indexed by Z5. Typed WORD from the assignments.

stubs.name: R23500Z3
stubs.note: File register R23500 indexed by Z3 (L02 module sensor-type area). MOV destination.

stubs.name: R23600Z3
stubs.note: File register R23600 indexed by Z3 (L02 filter setting). MOV destination.

stubs.name: R23700Z3
stubs.note: File register R23700 indexed by Z3: L02 analog input value area.

stubs.name: R23940Z3
stubs.note: File register R23940 indexed by Z3 (sensor-type setting). MOV destination.

stubs.name: R600
stubs.note: File register R600 (packed data word).

stubs.name: RST
stubs.note: GX Works RST(EN, d): resets bit d to FALSE when EN is TRUE, otherwise leaves it unchanged.

stubs.name: SET
stubs.note: GX Works SET(EN, d): sets bit d to TRUE when EN is TRUE, otherwise leaves it unchanged.

stubs.name: TCO_DINT_50
stubs.note: TimeControl global ticker updated by an interrupt: one tick every 50 ms. The call sites use it as a DWORD (dwTimeStart := TCO_DINT_50; DSUB). The stub never changes it, so it stays 0.

stubs.name: TIME_TO_DINT
stubs.declaration:
FUNCTION TIME_TO_DINT : DINT
VAR_INPUT
    IN : TIME;
END_VAR
END_FUNCTION
stubs.note: Standard conversion from TIME to DINT. On the PLC, TIME is a 32-bit millisecond count, but RuSTy stores TIME internally in nanoseconds. Because the scale is unclear, the body is left empty and returns 0.

stubs.name: Z3
stubs.note: Mitsubishi FX index register Z3, a 16-bit device used to offset device addresses (D8030Z3, R23500Z3). The call sites assign INT values to it.

stubs.name: Z4
stubs.note: Mitsubishi FX index register Z4, a 16-bit device used for indexed addressing (M0Z4).

stubs.name: Z5
stubs.note: Mitsubishi FX index register Z5, a 16-bit device used for indexed addressing (D0Z5, R0Z5).

stubs.name: Z6
stubs.note: Mitsubishi FX index register Z6, a 16-bit device.

stubs.name: Z7
stubs.note: Mitsubishi FX index register Z7, a 16-bit device.
